echoParts: of all the LORD’s good promises
verseText: Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled.
meaning: God kept all the promises he made to the Israelites. And he keeps all the promises he makes to us.

recall.question: How many of the LORD's good promises failed?

meaning.question: What does this teach about God?

application.prompt: Choose one promise of God you know and thank Him that He is faithful to keep it.
